title: Noodling Nudibranch
statement: Cruising unhurriedly over stacks of mossy slate that resemble sunken bookshelves, this translucent sea slug ripples with warm bioluminescent patterns whenever it appears to be puzzling out a particularly delightful thought. It spends its twilight hours nudging iridescent pebbles into intricate, temporary constellations on the sand before getting happily sidetracked by a passing bubble.
